items.example: She had the foresight to save some money.
items.exampleTr: Biraz para biriktirecek ileri görüşlülüğü vardı.
items.simple: Thinking about what might happen later, so you are ready.

items.example: Her talk gave me real insight into how people think.
items.exampleTr: Konuşması bana insanların nasıl düşündüğüne dair gerçek bir kavrayış kazandırdı.
items.simple: Suddenly understanding something deep that you did not see before.

items.example: The only drawback is the price.
items.exampleTr: Tek dezavantajı fiyatı.
items.simple: A bad part of something that is otherwise good.

items.example: He's a man of great integrity.
items.exampleTr: Çok dürüst ve ilkeli bir adam.
items.simple: Always doing the right thing, even when nobody is watching.

items.example: We don't have much leverage in this negotiation.
items.exampleTr: Bu pazarlıkta elimizde pek koz yok.
items.simple: Something that gives you power to get what you want.

items.example: Everyone has some kind of bias, even if they don't notice.
items.exampleTr: Fark etmese de herkesin bir önyargısı vardır.
items.simple: Liking one side more, so you are not fair.

items.example: You miss a lot of nuance when you read a translation.
items.exampleTr: Çeviri okurken birçok nüansı kaçırırsın.
items.simple: A very small difference in meaning that is easy to miss.

items.example: Travelling gave me a whole new perspective.
items.exampleTr: Seyahat bana tamamen yeni bir bakış açısı kazandırdı.
items.simple: The way you look at a thing. Others may see it differently.

items.example: We've got momentum, so let's keep going.
items.exampleTr: İvme yakaladık, devam edelim.
items.simple: When things are going well, and it gets easier to keep going.

items.example: One common pitfall is trying to do everything alone.
items.exampleTr: Yaygın bir tuzak, her şeyi tek başına yapmaya çalışmak.
items.simple: A hidden problem that is easy to fall into.

items.example: It's all about having the right mindset.
items.exampleTr: Her şey doğru zihniyete sahip olmakla ilgili.
items.simple: The way you usually think about things, good or bad.

items.tr: ödünleşim, bir şeyden vazgeçip diğerini kazanma
items.example: There's always a trade-off between speed and quality.
items.exampleTr: Hız ile kalite arasında hep bir ödünleşim vardır.
items.simple: To get one good thing, you must give up another good thing.

items.example: The upside is that we'll save a lot of time.
items.exampleTr: Olumlu yanı, çok zaman kazanacağız.
items.simple: The good part of a situation that is not perfect.

items.example: The visa was the last big hurdle.
items.exampleTr: Vize son büyük engeldi.
items.simple: A hard thing you must pass before you can reach your goal.

items.example: You need to set clear boundaries with your boss.
items.exampleTr: Patronunla net sınırlar koymalısın.
items.simple: A line you do not let others cross, like how you want to be treated.

items.tr: kapanış, bir şeyin geride kalması hissi
items.example: I needed closure after the breakup.
items.exampleTr: Ayrılıktan sonra bir kapanışa ihtiyacım vardı.
items.simple: The feeling that something sad is finished and you can move on.

items.example: That's outside the scope of this project.
items.exampleTr: Bu, bu projenin kapsamı dışında.
items.simple: How much a thing includes, and where it stops.

items.example: I don't have the capacity to take on more work.
items.exampleTr: Daha fazla iş alacak kapasitem yok.
items.simple: How much a person can do or hold at one time.

items.example: Sorry, that was an oversight on my part.
items.exampleTr: Üzgünüm, gözümden kaçtı.
items.simple: A mistake you make when you forget something by accident.

items.example: She has a knack for making people feel welcome.
items.exampleTr: İnsanları rahat hissettirmekte bir hüneri var.
items.simple: A natural, easy skill for doing one special thing well.

items.example: He built a good rapport with the clients.
items.exampleTr: Müşterilerle iyi bir uyum yakaladı.
items.simple: A friendly feeling between people who understand each other.

items.example: I miss the spontaneity of our early days.
items.exampleTr: İlk günlerimizin kendiliğindenliğini özlüyorum.
items.simple: Doing things at once, without a plan, because you feel like it.

items.example: Try to see the bigger picture here.
items.exampleTr: Burada büyük resmi görmeye çalış.
items.simple: Everything together, not only one tiny part.

items.example: Is it a failure? It's a matter of perspective.
items.exampleTr: Başarısızlık mı? Bakış açısına bağlı.
items.simple: Different people see it in different ways, so no one is wrong.
